name: frost_stipple
description: lilac and grey seahorse waves dusted with frost: fine feathered grain and sparkle stipple along the set, soft dark plumes in the valleys, each interior cell mottled
reuses: the smooth count through a cyclic map by rank (smooth_bands)
notes: Item 064 brought eight classic escape-time references (molemou, ovaline, touch, valhalla, underworld, under-a-brighter-sky, toxic-spire, molten) whose geometry is plain seahorse, spiral and dendrite, and whose look is their surface. No primitive was added: a texture probe at three seats found that orbit statistics already draw them. `stripe` at density 24 to 128 draws fine feathered strokes along the escape flow, decorrelating sample to sample near the set (a frost, a grain); at density 3 it swings slowly, so its troughs and crests read as cloth folds (2 still feathers). `gaussian_int` (the orbit's closest pass to the integer lattice) inverted at power 30 to 60 draws sparkle points scattered along the set (a stipple). `tia` and `curvature` draw soft plumes; `velocity` and `trap_circle` band too hard to be a texture.

The stack: the smooth count by rank at 1.5 cycles; `tia` inverted as a dark multiply (the valleys' plumes); `stripe` 64 as a pale screen near the set (the grain); `stripe` 256 at power 8, masked to the set, as the frost; `gaussian_int` inverted at power 30 as sparkle; the `inside` channel warped by `gaussian_int` (each interior cell mottled: ovaline's honeycomb, whose honey_cells entry kept nothing and left the library); a dark `de` hair. Round one's readings: s3_plumes (`curvature` in place of the frost: white plumes curling into the spirals), s3_dust (`stripe` 512, more grain), s3_plain (grain, frost and sparkle off: smooth_bands with plumes).

Explorer cost (080, `style cost`, read beside other Node workers: an upper bound): 288 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at its deepest kept seat (phoenix_d4ce71a6, maxiter 14,307), under the 5-minute bar.
